meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 里可用的本地模型、把提示词发给其中某个模型并取回回答,从而把部分任务交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求给容器 agent 接入 Atomic Chat 本地模型,或让 Claude 直接使用 Atomic Chat 里的模型时,此技能开始检查和配置。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都。
say.note: Claude 会调用本地模型回答。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 当前有哪些模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains two MCP tools: listing models available in Atomic Chat, and sending a prompt to a specified model to get its response, so it can offload work to local models.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to connect Atomic Chat's local models to the container agent, or wants Claude to use those models, this skill checks prerequisites and applies the configuration.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude will call a local model to answer.

say_en.text: List the models currently in Atomic Chat.
Use atomic_chat_generate with qwen2.5-coder to write a sorting function.
say_en.note: Model ID must match what Atomic Chat has.
